A sub-area of an area

Source: R/overlays.R
sub_area.Rd

Most sub-areas only change the area's rules, which zone_changes() says. Use sub_area() when a sub-area also adds setbacks, changes rules for one zone only, or caps dwellings (alone or shared with other sub-areas).

Usage

sub_area(
  changes = zone_changes(),
  additions = NULL,
  zone_parameters = NULL,
  max_dwellings = NULL,
  min_dwellings = NULL,
  max_floorspace = NULL,
  total_group = NULL
)

Arguments

changes

A zone_changes().

additions

A zone_changes() whose setbacks are added to the zone's.

zone_parameters

Named list of zone_changes() by zone key.

max_dwellings, min_dwellings, max_floorspace

Totals for the sub-area.

total_group

Sub-areas with the same total_group share one total.

Value

A list with class plancap_sub_area.

Examples

sub_area(zone_changes(height = height_limit(20, source = "I1.6.1(b)")),
         max_dwellings = 120, total_group = "BCD")
#> $height
#> $height$value
#> [1] 20
#> 
#> $height$source
#> [1] "I1.6.1(b)"
#> 
#> 
#> $totals
#> $totals$max_dwellings
#> [1] 120
#> 
#> 
#> $total_group
#> [1] "BCD"
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "plancap_sub_area"
